title: Canonical all-continuous scalar comparison without flatness
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with its norm topology and a finite intermediate field $E$. Let $A=C(-,E)$ and $B=C(-,\Omega)$ be the condensed rings of all continuous maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] and $a:A\to B$ postcomposition by the continuous inclusion [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. For every scheme $Z$ use $a_Z=p_Z^*a$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], ordinary unbounded derived categories and their module pullback and direct image [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and $T_Z=L\operatorname{Ext}_{a_Z}$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. For every $f:X\to Y$, define the canonical scalar/pullback isomorphism $\delta:T_Y f_B^*\simeq f_A^*T_X$ by its unique K-flat representative characterization: after the total-left-derived counits, it is the ordinary balanced tensor/pullback isomorphism induced by the scalar and geometric adjunctions, preserving insertion of the scalar unit. Existence and uniqueness of this normalized isomorphism are part of this construction [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Define $\beta_{f,K}:T_Y Rf_{*,A}K\to Rf_{*,B}T_XK$ to be the adjunct under $f_B^*\dashv Rf_{*,B}$ of $\delta_{Rf_{*,A}K}$ followed by $T_X$ of the counit $f_A^*Rf_{*,A}K\to K$. No flatness, boundedness, completion, or filtered-union coefficient interpretation is assumed.
